description:
You are an IT Project Manager launching a new cross-functional project called "Phoenix Migration" — a cloud infrastructure migration effort. You need to set up the full Rocket.Chat workspace for the project team.

Log in to Rocket.Chat:
- Username: admin
- Password: Admin1234!

Set up the project workspace:

1. Create a private channel named: phoenix-migration (this is the main project channel)
2. Set its topic to: Cloud Infrastructure Migration | Q1-Q2 2026 | PM: admin
3. Set its description to: Main coordination channel for the Phoenix cloud migration project
4. Create three public sub-channels: phoenix-frontend, phoenix-backend, phoenix-devops
5. Invite team members to the correct channels based on their role:
   - phoenix-migration (main): ALL team members (fe.lead, be.lead, qa.tester, ux.designer, pm.coordinator, devops.lead)
   - phoenix-frontend: fe.lead, ux.designer, qa.tester
   - phoenix-backend: be.lead, qa.tester
   - phoenix-devops: devops.lead, be.lead
6. Post a project charter message in #phoenix-migration containing: project name, timeline (Q1-Q2 2026), objective (migrate on-premise infrastructure to cloud), and list the team members with their roles
7. Pin the charter message
8. Post a sprint planning message in #phoenix-frontend with frontend-specific tasks (UI component migration, responsive testing)
9. Post a sprint planning message in #phoenix-backend with backend-specific tasks (API migration, database schema updates)
10. Post a sprint planning message in #phoenix-devops with devops-specific tasks (CI/CD pipeline, monitoring setup)
11. Send a direct message to pm.coordinator with a project summary asking them to set up the project tracking board
